basic_details.job_title: AAAL Synthetic Flight Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Alliance Air Aviation Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary of AIAHL) is filling 01 post of Synthetic Flight Instructor –ATR 72-SFI, open to Indian Nationals who are DGCA approved ATR-72 Synthetic Flight Instructors. The application goes by email to [email protected] and [email protected], and the last date of receipt of applications is 24 November 2026. A panel will also be formed for future requirement.

Age: As defined by the regulator. The application format asks for age as on the date of application, and states eligibility criteria as on the date of application. Salary and Emoluments: As per Company Policy. Benefits: Free/concessional air passages for the employee and his/her declared family on the Alliance Air network; the applicable taxes, levy and charges are paid by the employee. Nature of appointment: On joining, candidates will be appointed as SFI on contract for a period of 03 (Three) years, extendable subject to satisfactory performance. Bond: Candidates must execute a Fixed Term Employment Agreement and Indemnity Bond to serve the Company for 03 (Three) years; a candidate who leaves before completing 03 years of service would be liable to pay the Indemnity Bond amount to Alliance Air Aviation Limited. Posting: The selected candidate can be transferred to any other location within India due to operational requirement. | The notice does not name an educational degree for the post; the requirement is the DGCA approval as an ATR-72 Synthetic Flight Instructor. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

selection_process: candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria will be required to be available for a Virtual/Personal Interview. The notice does not give an interview date.

content_sections.heading: About Alliance Air Aviation Limited
content_sections.text: Alliance Air Aviation Limited describes itself in the notice as a wholly owned subsidiary of AIAHL. It operates the Alliance Air network, on which the selected Synthetic Flight Instructor will be entitled to air passages. The company's website named in the notice is www.allianceair.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email to both of the following officials named in the notice, so that it is received by 24 November 2026: Ms. Uma Sharma, Manager HR – [email protected] Ms. Aditi Dhami, Sr. Manager Ops. – [email protected] The application must be in the prescribed format available on the Career page of the AAAL website, www.allianceair.in , sent as a PDF with a recent passport size photograph pasted in the space provided in the Application Format. The notice does not specify an email subject line. The Format of Application, printed with the notice, asks for: Post applied for, endorsement details, date of endorsement, ATPL No. and date of expiry of the endorsement Name, father's name, address with PIN code, telephone, mobile, email, date of birth, age as on the date of application, nationality and religion Category (GEN, SC, ST, OBC or EWS) and whether CPL was obtained from IGRUA (if not, the institute's name and address) Educational qualifications from 10+2 onwards, previous employment, and licence details (ATPL, FRTO, COP/RTR, IR on ATR, ATR endorsement, any other endorsement) Class-I medical status, English Language Proficiency (ELP) level and validity, hours flown (single engine, multi engine, ATR and other aircraft) and any flying incident/accident with punishment or warning DGCA Computer No., passport details and a signed declaration that the information is correct The declaration in the form states that candidature will be rejected if any factual information is suppressed. The fee is payable to Alliance Air Aviation Limited via NEFT to the following account:

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Alliance Air invites applications from Indian Nationals for one post. Reservation of SC/ST/OBC and EWS candidates will be as per the Government Directives; the notice does not give a category-wise break-up for the single post. Post: Synthetic Flight Instructor –ATR 72-SFI (01 vacancy) Qualification and Experience: Should be a DGCA approved ATR -72 Synthetic Flight Instructor. Age: As defined by the regulator. The application format asks for age as on the date of application, and states eligibility criteria as on the date of application. Salary and Emoluments: As per Company Policy. Benefits: Free/concessional air passages for the employee and his/her declared family on the Alliance Air network; the applicable taxes, levy and charges are paid by the employee. Nature of appointment: On joining, candidates will be appointed as SFI on contract for a period of 03 (Three) years, extendable subject to satisfactory performance. Bond: Candidates must execute a Fixed Term Employment Agreement and Indemnity Bond to serve the Company for 03 (Three) years; a candidate who leaves before completing 03 years of service would be liable to pay the Indemnity Bond amount to Alliance Air Aviation Limited. Posting: The selected candidate can be transferred to any other location within India due to operational requirement. The notice does not name an educational degree for the post; the requirement is the DGCA approval as an ATR-72 Synthetic Flight Instructor. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: A PDF of the duly filled application form in the prescribed format, with a recent passport size photograph pasted in the space provided PDF copies of supporting testimonials for date of birth, caste, qualification and experience (such as appointment letter, photo identity card etc.) PDF copies of Licenses/Endorsement, updated Flying Logbook, NIL incident/accident certificate as applicable, latest PPC form and DGCA approval Copy of the endorsement certificate issued by DGCA (asked for in the hours-flown part of the form) SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates: caste certificate in the prescribed pro forma issued by the appropriate authority OBC candidates: certificate in the pro forma for Central Government employment, including the "Non-Creamy Layer clause", as per the Central list of OBCs; its validity should not be older than 06 (Six) months from the date of eligibility criteria EWS candidates: Income & Assets Certificate as per the annexure attached to the notice The notice includes the OBC certificate format and the EWS Income & Assets Certificate format. The EWS format certifies a gross annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh for the financial year and lists the assets the family must not own (5 acres of agricultural land and above, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above, or residential plots of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities or 200 sq. yards and above elsewhere).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: After scrutiny of applications, candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria will be required to be available for a Virtual/Personal Interview. The notice does not give an interview date. Eligible SC/ST candidates will be entitled to reimbursement of a second class return Rail/Bus ticket from the address given in the application to the nearest Selection Centre, on production of the railway receipt/ticket, as per rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Alliance Air Recruitment 2026 for Synthetic Flight Instructor –ATR 72-SFI?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy, and a panel will also be formed for future requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Alliance Air SFI post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Alliance Air ATR 72 SFI post?
faq.answer: The candidate should be a DGCA approved ATR -72 Synthetic Flight Instructor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Alliance Air SFI post?
faq.answer: The notice states the age as "As defined by the regulator", counted as on the date of application in the application format.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Alliance Air Synthetic Flight Instructor?
faq.answer: Salary and emoluments are as per Company Policy, along with free/concessional air passages for self and declared family on the Alliance Air network.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Alliance Air SFI post?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,500/- paid via NEFT to Alliance Air Aviation Ltd, Punjab National Bank, Account No. 0112005900000017, IFSC PUNB0011200; it is not applicable to SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Alliance Air SFI post?
faq.answer: Email a PDF of the prescribed application form with the required documents to [email protected] and [email protected], so that it is received by 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Alliance Air SFI post?
faq.answer: After scrutiny of applications, eligible candidates will be called for a Virtual/Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Alliance Air SFI job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract for 03 years, extendable subject to satisfactory performance, with a 03-year Fixed Term Employment Agreement and Indemnity Bond.

faq.question: Q10. Do SC/ST candidates get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible SC/ST candidates get reimbursement of a second class return Rail/Bus ticket to the nearest Selection Centre on production of the ticket, as per rules.
